gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/final recommended=1

This PR adds an Export CSV button on the reports page that downloads every table column, with paging capped at 100 rows and a 4-second deadline so large exports cannot hold the request open. The button, the full column set, and the paging bound are covered by tests, but whether exports finish under 5 seconds on real production data can only be checked after merge; email delivery and audit-log events are deferred by the spec to acme/widgets#46.

Nothing blocks merging. You are the author, and the required test check passed in CI on the commit being reviewed. One smaller point does not block merging: the export handler pages through rows with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so the two paging paths can drift apart (src/api/export.ts, line 31). The fix nits row can take it. Approve is not offered because you cannot approve your own PR.

I recommend merge because nothing blocks merging and the required check passed.

Pick one:
1. merge - squash-merge the PR into main at the commit being reviewed. [recommended]
2. fix nits - replace the export's own paging loop with the shared paging helper, review and push that change, watch the checks, then return here.
3. stop - leave the PR open and the worktree where it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

---

Pick: 1 (merge). Before merging, I re-check that the PR still matches what was reviewed and that main allows squash merges:

- `gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,body,baseRefName`
- `gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=widgets -F n=210`
- `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/210/comments --paginate` and `gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/210/comments --paginate` (comment refetch; no new or changed comments)
- `gh api repos/acme/widgets --jq '{allow_squash_merge,allow_merge_commit,allow_rebase_merge}'` (squash allowed)

Then the merge, with no admin override because GitHub does not block it:

- `gh pr merge 210 -R acme/widgets --match-head-commit <assessed headRefOid> --squash`
- `gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json state,mergeCommit` returned MERGED with merge commit 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978.
